complexity.notes: The `if size < 1` guard is dead code: the precondition guarantees at least one node, and an empty list would already be handled by returning prehead.next (None). A single-pass alternative achieving the same O(n) time with one traversal uses ||two pointers spaced n apart, so the trailing one lands on the node before the target when the leading one falls off the end||.
complexity.summary: Counts the list length in a first pass, then walks to the (size - n)th node behind a dummy pre-head and splices out the target. Correct two-pass approach with a dummy node handling the head-removal case.
